item.title: Gibson: Electrification Is Not New
item.description: BY ROBERT GIBSON Chair Los Alamos County Board of Public Utilities Electrification is the conversion to electric power of devices or processes that previously used other forms of energy. Today, the term commonly refers to conversions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from burning hydrocarbon fuels. That is not the only motivation. It may not even be the biggest. item.title: Obituary: Sofia Y. Chavez May 14, 1972 – Jan. 4, 2026
item.description: SOFIA Y. CHAVEZ Sunrise May 14, 1972 – Sunset Jan. 4, 2026 Sofia, a current resident of Velarde, NM, went to rest on January 4, 2026. She was born in Española on Mother’s Day, May 14, 1972, to Arlene and Johnny Chavez. Raised on the west side of Española, Sofia graduated from Española Valley High School in 1990 and later attended New Mexico State University, where she became a proud, lifelong Aggie. item.title: Los Alamos County Council Unanimously Elects Randall Ryti Chair And Ryn Herrmann Vice Chair For 2026 Term
item.description: Newly elected 2026 Council Chair Randall Ryti Staff Report Each January Los Alamos County Council elects its new leadership from among its members. At Tuesday’s meeting, Council unanimously elected Randall Ryti to serve as chair and Ryn Hermann as vice chair for the 2026 term. Voters first elected Ryti to serve on the County Council in the November 2018 General Election. He was re-elected to a second term in November 2022, which ends on Dec. 31, 2026.
